Welcome to The Square

A new chapter at the heart of the city.

Set beside Yerevan’s Republic Square, The Square brings a fresh energy to Armenia Marriott Hotel Yerevan. The restaurant and terrace make room for a quick coffee, a long lunch and evenings worth extending.

Come as you are. Take your time. There is always a place at the table.
